name: Logical replication ordered-marker convergence upper bound
description: Repeated disposable logical-replication runs that apply a bounded mutation set and wait for an ordered marker on one subscriber.

measurement.scope: Publisher server-clock interval from marker row timestamp before commit through a publisher clock sample after subscriber detection; includes commit, apply, client round trips, and polling delay; poll interval is 0.1 seconds.

assurance: A passing series proves ordered-marker observation, full retained-table signature equality, exact linked-run integrity, and repeatability for one disposable publisher/subscriber topology. It reports a polling-inflated upper bound, not pure WAL transport/apply latency, production lag, durability, failover behavior, or a causal comparison.
